products.name: Multi-Camera Editor
products.data_scope: Processes video and audio metadata; edited on-device within Premiere Pro. Does not upload content to cloud.
products.notes: Automates multi-camera sequence editing for up to 10 cameras and 10 microphones.

products.name: Social Clip Creator
products.data_scope: Creates and resizes video clips within Premiere Pro. On-device processing.
products.notes: Generates 1920x1080, 1080x1350, and 1080x1920 aspect ratio clips for social media.

products.name: Jump Cut Editor
products.data_scope: Analyzes audio silence patterns within Premiere Pro. On-device processing.
products.notes: Creates jump cuts based on silence detection (customizable decibel cutoff).
